Associate Label and the actual input through for and id. Use Error for the message and data-invalid on the field when the input is invalid.

## Usage

```ts
import { field, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/field';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/field`. It [registers](../../registration/) 10 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-field-field"></a>

### `shadcn.Field.Field`

Native exports include `components.Field`.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical" \| "responsive"` | Default `"vertical"` |
| `aria-label` | `null \| string` |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |
| `id` | `null \| string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `null \| string` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Field>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
